questions.question: Show that any graph where the degree of every vertex is even has an Eulerian cycle. Show if there are exactly two vertices $a$ and $b$ of odd degree, then there is an Eulerian path from $a$ to $b$. Show that if there are more than two vertices of odd degree, it is impossible to construct an Eulerian path.
